note: Cleveland NF campground in pine and oak on Palomar Mountain, a 2.25-mile trail below Palomar Observatory; several sites have level cement pads for telescopes. Only sites 40, 37/38 and 41/42 (the last two doubles) take a motorhome longer than 12 ft; the rest are tent or short-trailer sites. Showers and the flush toilet run in peak season only. --Claude
